JOB DESCRIPTION Sr. No. Role 1 Act as financial thought partner to the VP and Chairman — proactively surface risks, opportunities and capital-allocation recommendations from the numbers, and challenge business assumptions with data, beyond scheduled reporting. 2 Own the annual budgeting cycle (AOP) end-to-end: calendar, templates, department negotiations, Board approval and monthly budget-vs-actual discipline. 3 Deliver the consolidated group MIS (P&L, Balance Sheet, cashflow, project dashboards) across multiple group entities by the 10th of every month, reconciled to closed books. 4 Own quarterly re-forecasts of revenue, PAT and cashflow; drive forecast accuracy to within 5%. 5 Own financial evaluation of every new deal, land acquisition and JV: models (IRR / NPV / DSCR), scenario analysis and Go / No-Go notes within 7 working days — with a clear point-of-view recommendation, not options alone. 6 Own the project-finance control framework: cost-to-complete, margin trends and early-warning triggers on every active construction project. 7 Own investor and partner analytics: in

jobs.jd: This is essentially a Capex Accounting role with strong exposure to SAP, Ind AS, month-end closure, project accounting, and audit. 1. Role Brief Role: Capex / Fixed Assets / Project Accounting The person will be responsible for end-to-end accounting and financial control of capital expenditure (Capex) projects , starting from project purchase orders and invoices through capitalization, asset creation, depreciation, reconciliation, and reporting. The role will involve close coordination with Project, Procurement, Finance, Accounts Payable, Audit, and Management teams. Key responsibilities in simple terms Track and account for Investment Orders (IOs) and project-related expenditure. Monitor Capex budgets vs. actual spending . Review open POs and ensure old/unutilized POs are closed. Validate project invoices and accounting entries. Capitalize assets once projects are completed and assets are ready for use. Maintain the Fixed Asset Register and ensure appropriate asset tagging. Calculate/run depreciation and prepare asset/depreciation reports. Perform GL and vendor reconciliations . Support month-end/year-end closing. Prepare MIS, audit schedules and management reports. Ensure compliance with Ind AS, TDS and internal accounting policies . Support internal, IFC and statutory audits. Provide financial concurrence and tracking support for Capex projects.

For more about Group Bayport, please visit Website: https://groupbayport.com/about-us/LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/mycompany/ Role Overview We are looking for an experienced B2B Customer Service / Account Management / Key Account Management professional who can support the development and establishment of a structured Account Management Representative (AMR) function for the B2B business The selected individual will work closely with business leadership to understand the existing B2B customer management model and help carve out a clearly defined AMR structure , roles, responsibilities, account ownership, operating processes, service standards, escalation mechanisms, and day-to-day ways of working.
This role requires strong hands-on experience in managing B2B customers and key accounts , along with the ability to translate practical account management experience into a structured and scalable operating framework.
Help identify the right people/resources required for the AMR function.
B2B Account & Customer Management Bring hands-on experience in managing B2B customers, strategic accounts, and key accounts .
Help improve customer engagement, retention, service quality, and overall account experience.
Support the business in resolving cross-functional gaps impacting customer experience.
Provide leadership with insights on account performance, customer concerns, escalations, and improvement opportunities Required Experience & Skills Graduate with preferably 3–6+ years of relevant professional experience .
Strong hands-on experience in one or more of the following: B2B Customer Service B2B Account Management Key Account Management B2B Client Servicing B2B Customer Success Prior experience managing business customers and complex account requirements.
Experience working with multiple internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
Preferred Profile Candidates who have previously worked in a structured B2B Account Management / Key Account Management / Customer Service environment and have experience in establishing, improving, or scaling account management processes will be preferred.
Experience in defining roles and responsibilities, customer ownership models, escalation frameworks, or account management structures will be an added advantage.
Key Deliverables The person selected for this role will be expected to support the business in developing: A clearly defined B2B AMR structure Identification of appropriate people/resources for the AMR function AMR roles and responsibilities Account ownership framework Customer management processes KRAs and KPIs Service standards and SLAs Customer escalation framework Account review mechanisms Cross-functional operating model Reporting and performance tracking mechanisms Day-to-day AMR operating framework Success Measures Establishment of a structured AMR operating model Clear identification of AMR ownership and responsibilities Defined KRAs, KPIs, and service standards Improved B2B customer management processes Stronger customer communication and escalation mechanisms Improved coordination between Account Management and internal stakeholders Increased clarity and accountability across the B2B customer journey Overall improvement in B2B customer experience and account management effectiveness

jobs.jd: Job Summary Roastea is hiring a Credit Controller for its Vending Vertical to manage accounts receivable and ensure timely collections. The role plays a key part in maintaining healthy cash flow, controlling credit exposure, and coordinating with internal teams to resolve billing and payment-related matters. This position requires strong follow-up skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple Client accounts efficiently. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end accounts receivable for the vending business. Ensure timely and accurate invoicing as per agreed commercial terms. Monitor aging reports and follow up on outstanding payments. Conduct client visits for payment follow-ups, reconciliations, and issue resolution. Travel locally as required to meet clients for collections and account discussions. Maintain accurate client ledger reconciliations and resolve discrepancies. Coordinate with Sales and Operations teams for billing or service-related disputes. Monitor credit limits and highlight potential risk accounts. Negotiate payment schedules where required. Drive timely collections and work towards reducing overdue balances. Prepare periodic reports on collections and receivables status. Every Month Invoice submission to the clients as per the communicated time line. Requirements Bachelors degree in Finance, Accounting, or Commerce. 3to6 years of experience in credit control or accounts receivable. Experience in FMCG, beverage, vending, or B2B service industry preferred. Strong knowledge of accounting systems and MS Excel. Good negotiation and communication skills (Kannada and English). jobs.jd: Key Stakeholders: CMD, Finance Leadership, AR, AP, Tax & Compliance, Treasury/Funding, FP&A, Operations, Procurement, Projects and External Auditors Role Purpose The Finance Controller Closing & Reporting will be responsible for ensuring accurate, complete and timely financial closure and reporting across Redbrick Offices pan-India operations. The role will own the monthly, quarterly and annual book-closing process, maintain the integrity of the General Ledger and Balance Sheet, ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, and provide reliable financial statements and management reports to senior leadership. The incumbent will work closely with AR, AP, Taxation, Treasury, FP&A and business teams to ensure that all financial information is accurately captured, reconciled and reported within defined timelines. Key Responsibilities 1. Financial Closing & General Ledger Own the monthly, quarterly and annual financial closing process across entities, centres and cost centres. Establish and manage a detailed month-end closure calendar with clear ownership and timelines. Target completion of monthly financial closure within T+5 to T+7 working days. Review the General Ledger and ensure completeness and accuracy of accounting entries. Review journal entries, accruals, provisions, prepaid expenses, depreciation, revenue recognition and other closing adjustments. Ensure all material income and expenses are accounted for in the appropriate reporting period. Review unusual, exceptional and manual journal entries before closure. Ensure appropriate cut-off procedures for revenue, expenses, purchases and liabilities. Identify and resolve long-outstanding or incorrectly classified GL balances. Maintain appropriate maker-checker controls throughout the closure process. 2. Fina
